# Force Sports & Wears India

> Leading B2B manufacturer and global exporter of custom sublimated sports jerseys, athletic teamwear, school sports uniforms, and bulk t-shirts based in Mumbai, India.

## About Force Sports
- Founded: 2007 by Anand Sanghai
- Headquarters: 5/31, near Jain Hospital, Motilal Nagar III, Goregaon West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400062, India
- Factory & Capability: In-house sublimation printing, pattern making, automated cutting, precision stitching, and quality control.
- Core Fabric Innovation: Proprietary Sportex technical fabrics (micro-poly, dot-knit, honeycomb, waffle, interlock, four-way stretch, dry-fit with moisture-wicking and anti-microbial treatments).
- Production Capacity: 50,000+ units monthly.
- Delivery: Pan-India express delivery and global wholesale shipping.

## Core Product Categories
- [Custom Cricket Jerseys](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/products/cricket): Sublimated T20 team kits, test whites, practice t-shirts, caps, and track pants.
- [Football Kits](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/products/football): Match jerseys, shorts, goalkeeper kits, travel polos, and training bibs.
- [Kabaddi Uniforms](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/products/kabaddi): Heavy-duty stretchable mats-grade jerseys and shorts.
- [Badminton & Tennis Apparel](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/products/badminton): Ultra-lightweight moisture-wicking performance tees and court shorts.
- [Pickleball & Volleyball Teamwear](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/products/pickleball): Tournament jerseys, quick-dry shorts, and team caps.
- [School & Institutional Sports Uniforms](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/uniforms): Custom annual sports day house t-shirts, school tracksuits, and PT uniforms.
- [Corporate & Event Bulk T-Shirts](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/catalog): Sublimated promotional t-shirts, marathon running vests, and polo shirts.

## Technical Fabrics (Sportex)
- [Sportex Fabric Library](https://www.forcesportsindia.com/fabrics):
  - Sportex AeroLite (140-160 GSM, high breathability, rapid dry)
  - Sportex ProCool (160-180 GSM, moisture-wicking honeycomb)
  - Sportex ToughSkin (200-240 GSM, heavy tear resistance for contact sports like kabaddi)
  - Sportex FlexFit (4-way stretch poly-spandex blend for compression & leggings)

## Wholesale & B2B Inquiries
- Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): Typically 15-25 units for custom club kits; bulk enterprise tiers for 100 to 10,000+ units.
- Customization: 100% full-body sublimation printing, individual names & numbers, sponsor logos, rubber badges, embroidery.
- Turnaround Time: 7 to 14 working days from design approval.
